en: The image depicts a postcard with illustrations of a flag on each half: the upper half displays a greenish flag with a coat of arms showing a conifer tree surrounded by laurel branches and the inscription 'Võrumaa Kaitsemaleva'; the lower half shows a yellow flag with an eagle holding a shield. The flagpoles have ornate tips and tassels, and the postcard includes a scale at the bottom. There is also printed text in red above the flags.
